about: Get my accounts, on the demo bank (gw 2.0/DEMO_BANK.md D9). Needs the published demo bank and a dev server started with WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS=--remote-debugging-port=9340; see the top of make.mjs.

card.head: Get my accounts. One press.
card.sub: Groundwork visits your bank for you, on your computer, with no middleman holding your login. Shown on a made-up bank.

scenes.say: Groundwork 2.0 can fetch your bank statements for you, with one press. Here it is, on a made-up bank and a made-up household.

scenes.do: const d = await API.get('/api/settings/bank-logins?all=1'); const a = d.accounts.find(x => x.name === 'Everyday Checking'); window.__key = a.key; openAutomationRow(a.key); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); toggleAutoRow(a.key); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); if (!document.querySelector('[data-auto-key="' + a.key + '"].open')) toggleAutoRow(a.key);
scenes.say: On the Assistant page, each account has its bank's website. This one is Demo Credit Union, a pretend bank on Groundwork's own site.

scenes.after: await saveBankLogin(__key); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200));
scenes.say: Save the login once. It goes into your computer's own password vault. Groundwork's makers never see it, and no other company holds it.

scenes.winTitle: Demo Credit Union - showing Groundwork how
scenes.say: Then show Groundwork once. It opens your bank in a window of its own, and you sign in and do your usual download.

scenes.winTitle: Demo Credit Union - showing Groundwork how
scenes.say: If your bank texts you a code, you type it, as you always would. Groundwork never reads a code, and never asks you for one.

scenes.winTitle: Demo Credit Union - showing Groundwork how
scenes.say: Pick the account, the dates and the file type, the same way you do today.

scenes.after: await saveBankRecipe(__key); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200)); document.getElementById('autoImportPrompt')?.remove();
scenes.say: Groundwork noted each button you pressed, by its name. Never what you typed, and never a balance or an account number.

scenes.focus: [...document.querySelectorAll('header button, .topbar button, button')].find(b => __vis(b) && b.textContent.includes('Get my accounts'))
scenes.say: From now on it's one press. Get my accounts sits at the top of every page.

scenes.winTitle: Demo Credit Union - Groundwork is fetching your download
scenes.say: Groundwork signs in from your vault and follows your steps. When the bank asks for a code, its window comes to the front, and Groundwork waits for you to type it.
The statement comes straight from your bank to your computer. Nothing passes through anyone else.
Then Groundwork offers you the file, already matched to the account it came from.
Nothing reaches your records until you've looked. Lines you already have are held back, so only what's new goes in.

card.kicker: No middleman · No stored codes · Never pays
card.head: Your bank, your computer, nothing in between.
card.sub: Free for Windows, macOS and Linux · groundworkfinance.app

scenes.say: Your login stays in your own vault, every code is typed by you, and Groundwork never presses Pay. Groundwork 2.0 is free.
